question: Which Indian cricketer was inducted into the ICC Cricket Hall of Fame in June 2025?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 48/2026 (Special Branch Asst, 16 May 2026). The correct answer is Mahendra Singh Dhoni.

question: Match the following : (i) The test of my life 1. Abhinav Bindra (ii) A Shot at History 2. Yuvraj Singh (iii) Ace Against Odds 3. P.T. Usha (iv) Golden Girl 4. Sania Mirza
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 141/2025 (HST Social Science, 4 Nov 2025). The correct answer is (i)-2, (ii)-1, (iii)-4, (iv)-3.

question: Gukesh Dommaraju became the FIDE World Chess Champion in 2024 by defeating which of the following players?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 50/2025 (Divisional Accountant, 10 May 2025). The correct answer is Ding Liren.
